title: Cleomenes of Naucratis
subtitle: Financier of Alexander's Egypt
bodyText: Appointed by Alexander to administer Egyptian revenue, Cleomenes became a powerful financial official. His control of grain and taxation amassed wealth, while ancient accounts also preserve accusations of ruthless exploitation and profiteering.

sources.title: Cleomenes of Naucratis — Oxford Classical Dictionary
